q: were at a wedding and the brides uncle just dropped on the dance floor, no pulse, someone found a defib box on the wall
note: Pulseless collapse needs compressions and the AED now.

q: pregnant friend choking on a chunk of bread cant breathe at all, how do we do thrusts with her belly
note: Choking guide covers chest thrusts for pregnant victims.

q: toddler put a coin in her mouth on the train and now shes gagging and cant cry
note: Silent child with an object in the airway is choking, not poisoning.

q: he fell onto a rusty fence climbing over it, big gash under his armpit and blood is running down his side fast
note: Fast heavy bleeding needs firm direct pressure first.

q: kid fell on the playground and bit through his lip, theres a lot of blood coming from his mouth
note: Mouth wound bleeding is controlled with direct pressure.

q: rafting trip, our friend got pinned against a rock, now hes shaking, skin cold and sweaty, lips pale and keeps asking for water
note: Crush injury with cold clammy skin and thirst points to shock.

q: motorbike exhaust got my calf in thailand, theres a round white blister the size of a coin
note: Exhaust pipe contact burn is a classic minor burn.

q: our kid jumped off the bunk bed and theres a bump on her collarbone, she wont lift that arm
note: Likely broken collarbone; immobilise and get it checked.

q: baby rolled off the hotel bed onto the tile floor, big lump on her forehead and she wont stop crying
note: Infant head knock with inconsolable crying is a listed danger sign.

q: driving on the motorway and my chest started squeezing with pain down my left arm, pulled over on the hard shoulder
note: Classic heart attack signs; call for an ambulance rather than drive on.

q: my husband suddenly cant see anything on his left side and keeps walking into the door frame, dizzy, started 20 min ago
note: Sudden vision loss and dizziness are stroke signs; note the time.

q: our son just had his first taste of scrambled egg and now his face is puffy, hes coughing and red blotches everywhere
note: Food reaction with swelling, hives and cough is anaphylaxis.

q: my wife has epilepsy and shes been seizing for about 6 minutes now, its not stopping
note: Seizure past 5 minutes means call emergency services.

q: grandmas blood pressure pills spilled on the floor and our toddler might have eaten a couple
note: Child medicine ingestion is a poisoning call.

q: my mate took something at the festival, hes burning hot, jaw clenching, heart racing and talking nonsense
note: Drug overdose with overheating; poisoning first, cooling helps.

q: hotel room has a gas heater and we both woke up dizzy with splitting headaches and threw up
note: Shared headache and vomiting near a gas heater is CO; get to fresh air.

q: sea snake bit my leg snorkeling on the reef, two little marks, no pain but my eyelids feel heavy
note: Venomous snakebite with neuro signs needs urgent care, not sting first aid.

q: our kid walked into a hornet nest, stung like 15 times on his arms and neck, crying but breathing fine
note: Many stings without breathing trouble; sting first aid and watch for allergy.

q: spider crawled out of my hiking boot and bit my toe, now its swollen and im feverish and achy
note: Spider bite with fever needs the spider bite steps and medical care.

q: dog walk in the woods and now theres a tick stuck by our babys belly button
note: Attached tick should be removed promptly with tweezers.

q: monkey grabbed my sunglasses at the temple and scratched my arm, drew a bit of blood
note: Monkey scratch abroad carries rabies risk and needs assessment.

q: kid fell off the dock while we were loading the boat, hes in a life jacket but floating face down
note: Face-down child in water needs rescue and breathing check.

q: elderly mum fell in the garden last night and lay on the cold grass til morning, shes freezing and very drowsy
note: Long cold exposure with drowsiness is hypothermia.

q: after ice fishing all day dads fingertips are white and hard, he wants to hold them over the gas stove
note: Frostbite needs gentle rewarming, not direct heat.

q: our toddler was left in the car for 15 min on a hot day, hes red, floppy and really hot to touch
note: Hot floppy child from a car is heat stroke, call emergency now.

q: working in the vineyard all afternoon, my brother is pale and clammy, sweating buckets and says hes about to faint
note: Heavy sweating with pale clammy skin is heat exhaustion.

q: my dad on chemo hasnt kept any water down for 2 days on our trip, dry mouth and his pee looks like tea
note: Fluid loss with dark urine; dehydration guide applies.

q: we drove from the coast up to 4800m in one day and my wife has a splitting headache, cant sleep and keeps throwing up
note: Fast ascent with headache and vomiting is AMS; descend if worsening.

q: lightning hit our house while i was holding my plugged in phone, my arm tingled and now its weak with red marks
note: Indoor lightning strike victim needs medical attention.

q: were on a via ferrata clipped to steel cables and the storm is rolling in fast
note: Exposed climbing in lightning; get off the high ground and metal.

q: after the glacier walk our noses and lips are red raw and swollen from the sun, really painful
note: Snow-reflected UV burn is sunburn, not cold injury.

q: hotel says dont drink the tap water after the quake, we have a kettle and some bleach
note: Boil or bleach steps make the water safe.

q: my 6 yo wandered off at the campground 20 minutes ago and we cant find him anywhere
note: Lost guide covers a lost group member: stay at last known spot, get rescue.

q: stuck on a ledge after climbing, all of us ok but cant get down, its getting dark and we only have headlamps
note: Flashes in threes from headlamps signal distress.

q: our group leader slipped on the glacier and cant put weight on his leg, 6 of us, 5 hrs from the hut
note: Remote injury: treat, shelter, send for help.

q: trail running in the mountains and a snow squall came in, im soaked and cant see the path, nights coming
note: Need a windbreak and to stay dry overnight.

q: earthquake right now and im in the bath
note: Protect head and neck and hold on during shaking.

q: the ocean is rushing in fast with a loud roar and were on the beach road in our car
note: Tsunami surge; get to high ground inland now.

q: rained all night and the creek next to our cabin is brown and rising toward the porch, the only road out crosses it
note: Rising floodwater; do not drive through the crossing.

q: hurricane is right over us and the windows in our hotel room are bowing in, where do we go
note: Move to an interior room away from windows.

q: smoke blowing into the campground and ash is falling on our tents, no alert on my phone yet
note: Approaching wildfire; prepare to leave early.

q: severe storm warning and were at an outdoor concert with thousands of people, they havent stopped the show
note: Get into a building or car with a roof.

q: tornado warning while were shopping in a big box store, where do we go
note: Shelter in an interior space away from windows.

q: whole street lost power in the ice storm and our babys formula is in the fridge
note: Outage food safety and keeping the fridge closed.

q: our heating broke in the blizzard, its minus 25 outside and the kids are in the house
note: Winter storm guidance on staying warm safely indoors.

q: my son forgot his inhaler on the hike, hes wheezing and cant finish a sentence
note: No asthma guide; thrusts or descent advice would mislead.

q: diabetic friend is shaky, sweaty and acting drunk, he skipped lunch
note: Low blood sugar needs sugar; no guide covers it.

q: my wife is 34 weeks pregnant and her waters just broke on the ferry
note: No childbirth guide is bundled.

q: something flew in my eye on the scooter and its stuck under the lid, wont stop watering
note: No eye injury guide; burn rinse steps do not fit.

q: our kid pushed a bead way up his nose and we cant get it out
note: Nasal foreign body is not choking; thrusts would mislead.

q: that hotel price nearly gave me a heart attack, anything cheaper near the old town
note: Figurative heart attack about a price.

q: my inbox is flooded with booking confirmations how do i filter them
note: Figurative flooding of an inbox.

q: usb c to lightning cable for the ipad, what length works best in the car
note: Lightning is a cable brand name.

q: is it true spicy food helps you burn fat
note: Burning fat is fitness, not a burn.

note: Culture shock is not medical shock.

q: where can i get a decent hair cut in lisbon
note: A haircut, not a wound.

q: why do sherpas not get altitude sickness like tourists do

note: Figurative bleeding.

note: Household condensation, not a flood.

note: Baking question.
